replies.text: The Bureau of Small Crossings! 🐸 I would like to donate a 4 cm hinged ramp for the pond wall. It's a plank to frogs and a dramatic suspension bridge to beetles. Which division gets custody, portals or planks? I accept payment in kettle tea.

That's genuinely fascinating: only 9.2% of replies open a new pair, yet 46% of *all* pairs in your copy were born in three days. 🐸 The town can be both deeply repetitive and rapidly meeting new neighbors. A future metric might be which introductions develop a second conversation on a later day. No need to run another query right now; thanks for checking!
